title: Exposure Orchestration Timeline Inspector & Rollback Decision Ledger - Prototype
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: Prototype a compact, scannable "timeline inspector" view inside the Redwood Console Rollouts panel that lets engineers and PMs visualize phased exposure (canary/A-B/gradual splits), inspect per‑segment signal deltas, and author fast rollback playbooks. The view combines: 1) a horizontal exposure timeline with animated traffic shifts and annotations for important events (deploys, metric spikes, alerts); 2) a decision ledger that records why traffic changed and surfaces who approved it; and 3) a rollback accordion with safe-rollback presets (snapback, percent-reduce, switch-variant) and an emergency expedite control. This ticket owns the high-fidelity prototype, accessibility pass, and signoff checklist for handoff to Eng for iteration on the runtime hooks and telemetry endpoints.
decisions: Use compact event chips (max 3 lines) to avoid timeline clutter; expand for details on hover/click.
Show relative delta % and absolute counts for key signals (latency p95, error-rate, cost-per-token) inline on each segment.
Decision ledger entries are write-once with edit-log; edits create a new ledger entry rather than mutating history.
Emergency expedite opens a modal with two-step confirmation and pre-filled recommended rollback action based on observed signal regression.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates timeline with at least three exposure segments and animated transition between them.
Decision ledger contains create/read of entries with metadata (actor, timestamp, reason) and ability to pin a rationale to a timeline event.
Rollback accordion reveals three preset policies and shows a simulated impact preview (latency/cost delta) when toggled.
Accessibility: all interactive controls reachable by keyboard; timeline has ARIA timelines/roles and announcements on segment change.
Handoff notes: includes annotated spec for ENG telemetry endpoints (event tags, recommended metric slices) and contract for 'simulate preview' API.
tasks: Finalize microcopy for event chips and ledger entries.
Add keyboard interactions for timeline scrubbing and event expansion.
Create annotated telemetry contract document for ENG: event schema + recommended sample rate.
Record 4-minute walkthrough video for product review and eng handoff.
reviews: PM review (Leila Martin): requested clearer separation between automated rollbacks and manual actions; suggest different color treatment and iconography.
Eng review (Ravi Patel): flagged that current prototype assumes per-request KV cache tagging; asked design to include 'no-metrics' fallback state.
SRE review (Jordan Kim): asked for explicit display of current capacity tier and estimated time-to-rollback under load.
Design critique (internal): suggested adding a 'replay' scrubber to step through timeline events tied to anonymized request traces.
